episode_summary: In this episode, Alex Maldonado shares strategies for helping first-time homebuyers navigate closing costs using seller and lender credits. He emphasizes the importance of optimizing Google business profiles and leveraging bilingual marketing to reach the Hispanic community. Alex also discusses the value of building relationships with renters to convert them into future buyers.
